```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(imputeTS)
library(tsibble)
library(zoo)
library(patchwork)
```

```{r}
data <- read_csv("wellington.csv") %>%
  mutate(Date = yearmonth(paste(Year, Month))) %>%
  select(-Month, -Year) %>% # removed month and year because we already have date.
  as_tsibble(index = Date)

colSums(is.na(data))

scan_gaps(data)

data <- data %>%
  fill_gaps()

# Convert to ts for imputeTS methods
temp_ts <- ts(data$Temperature, frequency = 12)

# Create a comparison dataframe with all methods
comparison <- data %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(
    Original        = Temperature,
    LOCF            = as.numeric(na.locf(temp_ts, na.rm = FALSE)),
    NOCB            = as.numeric(na.locf(temp_ts, fromLast = TRUE, na.rm = FALSE)),
    Linear          = as.numeric(na_interpolation(temp_ts, option = "linear")),
    Spline          = as.numeric(na_interpolation(temp_ts, option = "spline")),
    Seasonal        = as.numeric(na_seadec(temp_ts, algorithm = "interpolation"))
  ) %>%
  select(Date, Original, LOCF, NOCB, Linear, Spline, Seasonal) %>%
  pivot_longer(-Date, names_to = "Method", values_to = "Temperature")

# Plot all methods
comparison %>%
  mutate(Method = factor(Method, levels = c("Original", "LOCF", "NOCB", 
                                             "Linear", "Spline", "Seasonal"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Date, y = Temperature)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(~ Method, ncol = 1) +
  labs(title = "Wellington Monthly Temperature — Interpolation Method Comparison",
       y = "Temperature (°C)", x = "Date") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
  
data <- data %>%
  mutate(Temperature = na_seadec(Temperature, algorithm = "interpolation", frequency(12)))

data <- data %>%
  mutate(Temperature = as.numeric(Temperature))

training <- data %>%
  filter(Date <= yearmonth("2025 April"))

test <- data %>%
  filter(Date > yearmonth("2025 April"))
```

```{r plots}
data %>%
  autoplot(Temperature) +
  labs(title = "Wellington Monthly Temperature",
       y = "Temperature (°C)",
       x = "Date") +
  theme_minimal()

data %>%
  gg_subseries(Temperature) +
  labs(title = "Wellington Temperature Seasonal Subseries",
       y = "Temperature (°C)",
       x = "Month") +
  theme_minimal()

data %>%
  model(STL(Temperature ~ trend() + season(window = "periodic"))) %>%
  components() %>%
  autoplot() +
  labs(title = "STL Decomposition of Wellington Temperature") +
  theme_minimal()

data %>% gg_tsdisplay(Temperature, plot_type = "partial")
```
